name: NZBN API - entity search (needs free subscription key)
note: Returns HTTP 401 without a subscription key. Register on the api.business.govt.nz developer portal for a free key. Paginated; itemsPerPage param controls page size.

name: NZBN API - entity detail by NZBN (needs free subscription key)
note: Replace {nzbn} with a 13-digit NZBN. Returns the publicly available entity data (name, type, status, addresses, tradingNames, industryClassifications, companyDetails incl. company number).
